The frontend is built with `API_URL=https://api.localhost/api/v1/` for server-side use, which fails to resolve inside the container network. This is because the dev compose build args default to app.localhost/api.localhost, but the server-side `API_URL` should point to the backend service. In dev compose the build args are:
```
- API_URL=${API_URL:-https://api.localhost/api/v1/}
```
and my .env sets API_URL=https://api.localhost/api/v1/. For the frontend container, server-side requests to api.localhost fail DNS. In the prod compose, API_URL would be a container name.

The production template says `API_URL=SCHEMA://BACKEND-CONTAINER-NAME:PORT/API/VERSION`. So for docker deployment, API_URL should be http://backend:8000/api/v1/.
